description: v5.0 2.36.8.7/2.36.9.9/2.36.9.5: with STUDY_MODE=true, generation additionally produces speech-led study-only plans at deterministic target ratios, on top of the normal production build order. Study plans are never shown to users, never emitted to production ranking, use a separate judge-call budget (STUDY_MAX_JUDGE_CALLS_PER_REGION=10), and only populate Task 3 compression-band evaluation.

region_ground_truth.note: the whole fixture is treated as one Source Region for this scenario; D_clean is computed by d_clean_v1, not asserted here since that helper is still deferred (Phase 3/4).

expected.judge_call_budget: STUDY_MAX_JUDGE_CALLS_PER_REGION (10), separate from the production MAX_JUDGE_CALLS_PER_REGION (6)
